tenira.title: Tenira
tenira.tagline: Open it. Know what to do.
tenira.description: A workspace for small teams that turns tasks, deadlines, blockers, and context into a clear plan for the day.

meta.title: Tenira | Guilherme Reis
meta.description: How I structured Tenira, a work-management SaaS for small teams built with TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.

context.heading: Context
context.body: Tenira is a work-management SaaS for small teams, bringing projects, cycles, tasks, notes, calendar, and daily priorities into a single workspace.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.body: Small teams often lose track of what matters between tasks, deadlines, and context scattered across tools, making it hard to know what actually needs doing on a given day.

decisions.heading: Decisions
decisions.body: I structured the critical flows for authentication, access, business rules, and persistence with TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, and Supabase, prioritizing a solid foundation before expanding the product's surface.

stack.heading: Stack
stack.intro: The technologies behind the product, from the backend to deployment.

state.heading: Current state
state.body: Tenira is in production, with payments, product analytics, automated tests, and CI/CD, iterating continuously based on real usage.

anvero.title: Anvero
anvero.description: A SaaS that helps small businesses spot conversations that need a commercial follow-up and organize next steps on WhatsApp.

meta.title: Anvero | Guilherme Reis
meta.description: How I led the architecture at Anvero, a SaaS startup that prioritizes WhatsApp conversations with commercial follow-up potential.

context.heading: Context
context.body: Anvero is a SaaS startup focused on prioritizing WhatsApp conversations that need a commercial follow-up, turning messages into trackable follow-up flows.

problem.heading: Problem
problem.body: Businesses that serve customers over WhatsApp accumulate conversations that need commercial follow-up, and without a structured flow it's easy to lose opportunities in the volume of messages.

decisions.heading: Decisions
decisions.body: As CTO, I modeled the domains for organizations, teams, contacts, conversations, follow-ups, integrations, and automations, and drove the integration with Supabase, PostgreSQL, Edge Functions, and the WhatsApp Cloud API, including Embedded Signup and webhook processing.

stack.heading: Stack
stack.intro: The pieces connecting the domain model to the WhatsApp Cloud API.

state.heading: Current state
state.body: Between July and August 2026, I led the architecture and development at Anvero as CTO, with the domain model and core integrations already in place.
